articles.headline: No. 17 Minnesota women move to 8-0 with 69-50 win over Cincinnati in the Cancun Challenge
articles.description: — Natalie Kussow scored 22 points and grabbed 11 rebounds for No. 17 Minnesota, and the Golden Gophers pulled away in the third quarter to beat Cincinnati 69-50 on Friday night in the Cancun Challenge.

article.story: MINNEAPOLIS -- — Tayla Thomas and Mara Braun scored 15 points apiece and No. 17 Minnesota smothered Central Michigan 82-31 on Sunday. Natalie Kussow added 13 points and Gracie Merkle 12 for the Golden Gophers (6-0), who didn't allow the Chippewas to reach double figures in any quarter. Jailenn Green had nine points for Central Michigan (0-5), which went 2 of 21 from 3-point range and shot 24% overall (14 of 48) and was outrebounded by 24. Thomas scored 13 points in the first half and the Gophers opened a 36-15 lead as the Chippewas missed all 10 of their 3s and shot 24% overall. Thomas had two layups and Braun hit two 3-pointers as Minnesota raced to a 12-0 lead. It was 12 points at the end of the quarter and the lead passed 20 when Kussow had five points in a 10-0 run that made it 34-12. Minnesota had an 11-0 burst, six by Merkle, in the third quarter to make it a 36-point advantage and the Gophers scored the last six to make it 63-24. They also added the first seven of the fourth quarter. Up next Central Michigan: at St. Thomas on Tuesday.
